WITH filtered_item AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
),
filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-04-02' AND DATE '2001-06-01'
),
base_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        w.w_state,
        i.i_item_id,
        d.d_date,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_sales_price
    FROM filtered_item i
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN filtered_dates d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
),
top_groups AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT w_state, i_item_id
    FROM base_sales
    ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
    LIMIT 100
),
net_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        b.w_state,
        b.i_item_id,
        b.d_date,
        b.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0) AS adjusted_sales
    FROM base_sales b
    JOIN top_groups g
        ON b.w_state IS NOT DISTINCT FROM g.w_state
        AND b.i_item_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM g.i_item_id
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON b.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
        AND b.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    s.w_state,
    s.i_item_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.d_date < DATE '2001-05-02' THEN s.adjusted_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.d_date >= DATE '2001-05-02' THEN s.adjusted_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM net_sales s
GROUP BY s.w_state, s.i_item_id
ORDER BY s.w_state, s.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
